rationale: Both Andre and Haowen work in computer vision, but from complementary angles—Andre as a specialist and Haowen as a cofounder building robotics systems at Mach9 that rely on visual servoing and perception. Haowen's background in robot manipulation and visual servoing, combined with his systems-level experience from Apple and CMU, could benefit from Andre's focused expertise, while Andre may find insight into how computer vision integrates into real-world robotics products.
intro_message: Andre, meet Haowen Shi—cofounder of Mach9 Robotics and a CMU ECE grad working on visual servoing for robot manipulators. Given your computer vision background, you two should compare notes on perception in robotics.
